entities.summary: The International Federation of Philosophical Societies is a world organization for learned societies in philosophy. Its member-societies arguably include every country where there is significant academic work in this field. Members also include philosophical institutions at regional and international levels. International Federation of Philosophical Societies is a international organization in Europe, established in 1948. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
